propositions: The sidecar channel's _ALLOWED_FIELDS sanitization allowlist in failure.py admits ceiling fields (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but drops measurement fields (requests, tool_calls), recording what the limit was but never what was consumed.

Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic at all, while only completion_recovery.py:388-395 passes diagnostic data, causing plan-review and preflight gate errors to persist no counters.

The completion verdict sidecar carries no run metadata (requests, tool_calls, duration), creating asymmetry with the plan-review sidecar which already carries per-call requests and a metrics block, leaving the completion gate (whose budget was raised five times) without visibility.
Gate-run consumption data exists on disk in usage.jsonl per-checkout but is not visible to the store, making gate cost answerable locally but not from rebar audit show or for shared agent visibility.
